name: opencode-skill-registry
description: OpenCode plugin that generates a lightweight per-project index of skills and convention files.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prune-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bash scripts/test-skill-registry.sh && node tests/validate-pr-title.test.mjs && node tests/release-policy.test.mjs && node tests/package-publication.test.mjs && node tests/ci-workflow.test.mjs && node tests/publish-workflow.test.mjs && pnpm run test:install
scripts.security:check: pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run security:signatures
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run verify:workflows && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run verify:package
